events.factual_description: Roulette presents Bathed in Sound on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. The announced live program features the James Brandon Lewis Trio, Trap Music Orchestra, Angelica Sanchez, and the trio of Clinton Patterson, Sheela Bringi and Elden Kelly. The concert opens James Brandon Lewis's Thru Line, a three-night Roulette residency created as part of his 2026 Jazz Generations Initiative Continuum Fellowship. Roulette describes the fellowship and residency as bringing together improvisers, poets, musicians and multidisciplinary artists across media and generations. The performance is presented by the Jazz Generations Initiative in partnership with Roulette. Roulette lists $25 advance admission, $30 at the door, and $20 student/senior admission with ID; a free livestream is scheduled for 8:00 PM and will be archived for future viewing.

en.why_it_matters: Lewis is using the first Thru Line night as a thesis rather than a showcase. His trio sits beside Trap Music Orchestra, Angelica Sanchez, and Patterson, Bringi and Kelly in a program deliberately built to let different musical languages share the same room. The draw is that curatorial architecture: a tenor-saxophonist and improviser with a strong personal sound opening his fellowship residency by testing how ensemble identities, generations and genres can meet without being flattened into one style.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already workable on September 29, build the Brooklyn evening around Roulette. From farther down the corridor, pair it with another strong New York reason rather than making the entire trip depend on this one residency night.

es.why_it_matters: Lewis está usando la primera noche de Thru Line como una tesis, no como un showcase. Su trío comparte el programa con Trap Music Orchestra, Angelica Sanchez y el trío de Patterson, Bringi y Kelly en una noche armada deliberadamente para poner distintos lenguajes musicales en el mismo cuarto. Ahí está el atractivo: un saxofonista tenor e improvisador con una voz muy propia abre su residencia de fellowship probando cómo pueden encontrarse ensambles, generaciones y géneros sin quedar reducidos a un solo estilo.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya es viable el 29 de septiembre, armaría la noche de Brooklyn alrededor de Roulette. Desde más abajo en el corredor, la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para estar en Nueva York en vez de hacer que todo el viaje dependa de esta sola noche de la residencia.
